title: A fair measure allows a familiar ending

captions.energy: Considering help’s consequences for both people

meaning: Your care can stay honest when a new measure of help considers different needs while allowing sadness about a familiar arrangement ending.
text: Even a fair change need not feel only relieving. In the physical position of Anahata, Temperance expresses care through actions combining different needs without either disappearing. Justice in energy brings a wish to consider help’s consequences for both people and preserve an honest measure. Death in emotions offers the ending of a familiar arrangement. An accepted wish may feel tender while an earlier form of involvement is missed. Care allows both feelings without requiring the past to be declared unnecessary.

For example, you stop always having dinner late while waiting for one person’s classes to finish. You choose a small shared snack later while keeping the main meal at a convenient time for each. **A manageable measure can end a habit while preserving warmth.** A brief meeting remains yours although the former long dinner is not repeated. Attention appears in considered needs instead of one continually waiting or the other proving gratitude by abandoning a timetable to preserve an old form.

Honesty can become an argument against sadness because things now suit both. An ending loses human meaning and becomes correct calculation. Alternatively, a new measure hides former demands under another name. Care preserves concrete checking and permission to correct. A solution’s benefit can be recognised while the familiar is missed without automatically restoring it or making a feeling someone else’s duty.
